screen_question: Can a locally installed Qwen3.5 model replace Qwen2.5 7B in the unchanged full LeftBrain contract while clearly reducing latency and preserving structured cognitive-plan quality?

research_basis.relevant_claim: The model card reports 9B and 4B instruction-following results, non-thinking configuration, and agentic/tool-use support. These claims motivated local screening but were not treated as project evidence.
Function-call formatting is not guaranteed and applications must validate malformed outputs.

screen_input.text: 午後の予定が急に空いた。まだ何をするか決めてない。

matched_native_results.selected_core_message_jp: 今何するか迷ってるんだね。
matched_native_results.final_reply: 先に、今何するか迷ってるんだね。そのくらいでいいだろ。
quality_issues: BDI fields were Chinese rather than Japanese
the final reply added a formulaic tail
the selected plan did not offer a useful response to the open afternoon

matched_native_results.selected_core_message_jp: じゃあ、俺とどこかで軽く飲む？それともただのんびりしてるだけいいや。
quality_issues: used the wrong first-person form 俺
proposed an impossible physical drinking invitation
selected candidate BDI fields normalized to None

matched_native_results.selected_core_message_jp: 決まらなくてもいいよ。私はいつでもここにいるから、ゆっくり考えたりしててくれれば
quality_issues: used the forbidden first-person form 私
latency was slower than the native Qwen2.5 7B control
the selected content was truncated and did not clearly improve task response quality

transport_diagnostic.reason_for_native_rerun: The OpenAI-compatible Qwen3.5 4B call returned empty content after counting 2504 output tokens, so transport behavior could not be attributed to model quality.
transport_diagnostic.native_resolution: Ollama native think=false produced non-thinking JSON content for both Qwen3.5 candidates, removing the empty-content confound.

stop_reason: The 4B candidate was faster but violated persona, physical-action, and BDI contracts. The 9B candidate was slower than the current 7B control and still violated the first-person contract. No candidate justified a preregistered multi-case holdout.
limitations: Only one exploratory input was used; this is not an accuracy or quality estimate.
Full raw generations were inspected during execution but were not persisted; only bounded response fields and prefixes were retained in the execution record.
The screen does not evaluate fine-tuning, alternative quantization, speculative decoding, or a dedicated planner model.
The screen does not evaluate RightBrain model blending, memory, reflection, ToM, function calling, or VRM actions.
next_research_direction: Audit whether the repository contains enough high-quality, provenance-safe speech-plan supervision to train or distill a dedicated local planner; do not perform training until data readiness is demonstrated.
